steps.text: Pitch black.
Unfathomable depth, without a shred of sunlight. The stifling atmosphere almost feels as heavy as the roof's own weight.
The roof of a tomb.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What's going on...? Why am I back here?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Wei, old thing, still alive? I came to see you.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: (Hoarse howl)
The sound emanates from behind the heavy door before her.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You've been sleeping for so long, and you're still as pissy as ever...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Drop the scary act already. Can you even do anything after lying here all this time?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Hoo...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Nothing to be afraid of... right?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Shangshu?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Which mountain is this? Why isn't there a single road sign... no, what year is it even?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Judging from the houses by the road, this looks like Shangshu before it went nomadic... why does it look like the city I saw when I first got here?
*ding*— *dong*—
A man hangs from a steep cliff with a rope, engraving a sentence with the hammer and chisel in his hands.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Wei—you, up on the mountain! What'cha doing?

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: You don't know who I am?!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Why would I?

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: It was I who designed and created this city!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh, that's pretty cool.

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: The Catastrophe's about to arrive, and everyone's already evacuated. But the disaster will destroy all the houses I built.

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: I can't let it happen just like that!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: The fifth year of Jingyan, when I had just arrived here, and stayed for three decades... 'Record of Shangshu City'?

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: I'm carving how I crafted the city onto this cliff so future generations will remember my achievements!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: But the Catastrophe's just around the corner. You're risking your life for this, but what if a thunderbolt cleaves the mountain into two? Wouldn't your hard work be in vain?

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: I couldn't care less. This is the only thing I can do. Why even bother living, if no one will know of my feats?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: How do you even live like that...? Fine, just keep working, I'll disturb you no more.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Wei, where does this mountain path lead?

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: It's you...

steps.name: Blind Young Swordsman
steps.text: Sir, I wish for you to grant me a sword.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What for?

steps.name: Blind Young Swordsman
steps.text: To save. To avenge.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I've told you, my swords don't come cheap. What're you offering?

steps.name: Blind Young Swordsman
steps.text: My life.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Again...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: ...I should've said no already.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Do you hate me for giving you that rusty piece of scrap metal?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What am I saying? This is just an illusion.

steps.name: Blind Young Swordsman
steps.text: But you do remember me.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Just thinking about that screenplay draft... I still can't help but wonder if the story would've ended differently, had I given you a proper blade then.

steps.name: Blind Young Swordsman
steps.text: How can someone so remarkable and knowledgeable show compassion to a nobody like me?

steps.name: Blind Young Swordsman
steps.text: A mere mortal life is honestly worthless to you.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Hey, don't go that far. I still like you mortals a lot.

steps.name: Blind Young Swordsman
steps.text: You look at us as if you're watching a play.

steps.name: Blind Young Swordsman
steps.text: Your casual acts can add a little marvel to the show and change the fates of countless people. Sometimes you'll even be in the mood to join us for a few songs.

steps.name: Blind Young Swordsman
steps.text: But in the myriad of plays, you're the only one offstage.

steps.name: Blind Young Swordsman
steps.text: You've been alone all along.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Jeez, I didn't think I'd get this kind of hallucination...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I'm tired. Just take the sword. It's made for proper combat.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Let me see if the story ends differently.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Sir, a young man asked me to deliver this to package to you before the day of Dongzhi.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Don't have the guts to see me in person?

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: I suppose... he's passed on by now...
The bag is empty.

a.text: Countries turn to rust. A brief spark in the wind. A bubble gone without a trace.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: What's this...?

steps.name: Mr. Ruan
steps.text: Sir, I've been anticipating this for a long time.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You've been waiting for me?

steps.name: Mr. Ruan
steps.text: I'm puzzled by something that I'd like you to clarify.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Do elaborate.

steps.name: Mr. Ruan
steps.text: I went to collect references at the edge of the city today, and saw an odd fowlbeast perched by the riverbank.

steps.name: Mr. Ruan
steps.text: I've never seen a fowlbeast so beautiful... I was just about to whip out my brush and paper when it flapped its wings and vanished from sight.

steps.name: Mr. Ruan
steps.text: I tried to paint it from what I could remember, but I could not do it.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Just let it go, some things are beyond your control.

steps.name: Mr. Ruan
steps.text: That holds true for others, but I still call myself a painter for the time being... so I'll always want to capture it somehow.

steps.name: Mr. Ruan
steps.text: I've painted quite a lot these past few years. I always thought one had to paint plenty of paintings and see many sights to make life worthwhile.

steps.name: Mr. Ruan
steps.text: But I finally realized... that paintings are ultimately inanimate objects.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Mr. Ruan
steps.text: The scenes I paint turn into a passing cloud a moment later. The more I paint, the more insignificant I feel my paintings become.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: That's only natural, no?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: One can only dream of seeing the entire land if one won't even make it to a hundred years of age.

steps.name: Mr. Ruan
steps.text: No... I think you still don't understand.

steps.name: Mr. Ruan
steps.text: Sir, I'd like to ask for some thoughts on this undeserving work of mine.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Is this a painting?

steps.name: Mr. Ruan
steps.text: My painting.

steps.name: Mr. Ruan
steps.text: This is the view we ignorant mortals see.

steps.name: Mr. Ruan
steps.text: Even one like you with all the views you have seen are only a drop in the ocean when compared to the tumultuous changes this land has experienced over the last millennium.

steps.name: Mr. Ruan
steps.text: Please, take a good look once more.

steps.name: Mr. Ruan
steps.text: For we only have this one dusk.

a.text: Halt brush, wind scroll. As besotted as drunk. One dusk, to ash.

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: They're growing well...

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: Did you plant all these?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: The people here did.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: As you said, I can't use my abilities to meddle with their growth... I'll disappear one day, but these people will still be here for a long time.

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: You've worked so hard...

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: It's been a while, Shu.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: How very strange. That brother of mine has been telling me he's seen you in his dreams lately.

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: Why do you keep thinking about me...? Are you getting nostalgic with age?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: You know how to make fun of me too now.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: The people here all remember a 'Shennong' who compiled the twenty-four jieqi solar terms, taught them how to till the land, and even risked her life to cultivate a vast expanse of frozen soil into fertile fields.

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: How can I bear that title on my own? We achieved it all together, so why put everything on my shoulders?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: It's been so long, is there still a difference between you or me?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: All I remember is someone taking me in when I was wandering about aimlessly like a child, and giving me a home.

spans.text: All I remember is someone taking me in when I was wandering about aimlessly like a child, and giving me a

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: She told me I needn't care about the differences between man and beast... that I should just live as a human.

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: I didn't expect you to stay here even now.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: I promised you I would. To stay and guard this land, so people wouldn't have to go hungry.

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: Oh, Shu... have you ever resented me?

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: A thousand years. How can you call this devotion? This is clearly incarceration...

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: Even though your consciousness is gone, you're still trapped here by your ties to this land, rather than go free.

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: All because of one mistake I made...

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: I don't resent you for it... only myself. For not going north in your place.

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: Shu... You know I've never seen you as a Xian, the whole time we were together. I almost forgot that you weren't mortal.

spans.text: Shu... You know I've never seen you as a
the whole time we were together. I almost forgot that you weren't mortal.

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: I only realized when we parted ways, I had my own selfish motives, a 'human' selfishness.

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: I wanted to beg you to stay, to continue helping the people here. All of my kin need you.

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: But I wasn't sure if you would love them, as you loved me...

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: I'm afraid I've let you down.

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: So we failed in the end, right?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: You never found the seeds, and I never managed to grow crops on Originium-tainted soil.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: We couldn't even protect this land.

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: Man can prevail over nature... but when will that happen for real?

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: Shu... Do you regret it?

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: You knew that everything I said would come to pass, didn't you?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Yes, I always knew.

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: You shouldn't have met me here.

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: You're only a shred of consciousness left in this device, and I'm a memory within.

steps.name: Indistinct Woman
steps.text: I am you.

steps.name: Strange Creature
steps.text: Ghaah—?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You're still here.

steps.name: 'Free'
steps.text: I'm always with you.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: A command to want and rage, in greed for life and fear for death.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I nearly forgot why I even created you back then.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: No place of place amidst high mounts or waters far; no matter to me free amidst the human realm.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I've been muddleheaded for so long that I even lost track of why I'm awake.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Who ever said you had to paint the entire realm to be considered an artist? Just paint a realm, and true it be.
The painter brandishes her blade, and mounts rise in succession.
I am me.
And what I see is all.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Wei, wake up.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: A director can't be sleeping on set, right? That's crazy irresponsible.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What's wrong with taking a snooze when you're tired... which one are we shooting this time?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Mecha-Feranmut vs Feranmut.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh. Isn't that the screenplay I stashed away in the bottom of my drawer?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You mean it's that bad...?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I swear, this year is the last one.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Anything can be spun into a good story, that's what legends and strange tales are...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I gotta ask, li'l Lava.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What makes you so willing to humor me for so long?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: The legendary weapon you promised. When are you going to give it to me?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Sure enough, you're still after that...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Would you miss me, if I were to vanish one day without a trace? For good?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: If that day comes, no one will remember you.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: The weapons, tools, cities, and those films you made will all vanish... you know that.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You're right... I shouldn't be seeing you here either.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Yeah, you called it. The dumb stuff I waste time on again and again all amounts to nothing in the end. But I can't help it. I just wanna have some fun and leave some memories behind.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Leave something behind and have fun. That's enough for me.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Thanks, li'l Lava. It was pretty fun making trouble with you at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Humiliating... I ended up giving myself a lecture with something I crafted with my own hands.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Letting people go through these old and irrelevant memories just like that is really something...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Well, enough of that. We answered that question when we managed to split off from chaos.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You're just a heart. So stop dreaming about taking us back in.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: We worked hard to be free from that pitch-black tomb. We're not about to go back to living under your shadow, old thing.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: So I'll—
